commit.message:
Add try-with-resource block for snapshot in
ClassStaticFieldReachabilityTest.java.

Add a comment to explain why skipping past the array's byte size for
next id.

Add DumperSupport::dump_classloader_classes_array() for dumping
ClassLoader's loaded classes array.

Write synthetic <classes> array for ClassLoader (and subclass) instances
in HPROF heap dump.

This restores ClassLoader -> loaded_class reachability path in HPROF
heap dump after JDK-8391308. No additional Java heap array object or
native array is allocated for writing synthetic <classes> array.

Add ClassStaticFieldReachabilityTest.java jtreg test.
